And basically the record was so dope.</p>

<p>We had a little clearance issue in the beginning. The record’s on the album, it was a bonus exclusively through Target. That record was actually the record that inspired Benny and Cashmere make “Luv.”</p>

<p>I was bummed out that we couldn’t use the other one and Benny was just like, “No worries.
